rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent-fixing (Ord. 25-057)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not subscribe to, contract with or pay a service provider that collects nonpublic competitor rental information and uses software to recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy levels. Service providers may not facilitate agreements not to compete among landlords.
rules.key_value: ban on paying for algorithmic rent-setting services; subsequent violations fined $100 to $2,000, each day a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Real estate lessors, agents and subcontractors, and service providers, for residential dwelling units (houses, apartments, accessory units used as a primary residence)
rules.exemptions: Owners of multiple properties for actions relating exclusively to properties they control; licensed real estate agents acting in accordance with state regulations; inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, detention facilities
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
rules.conflict_note: Ordinance text gives adoption on 2025-05-21 (mayor approved 2025-05-22) but no effective date, so effective_date is null; X018 (law firm alert) says June 2025.
rules.interaction: NJ statewide algorithmic rent-setting law (P.L.2025, c.405) takes effect later and may overlap; flagged for human review.

notes: Ordinance text only (PDF of Ord. 25-057, not saved); it does not state an effective date. Chapter 260 rent control was not read.
